source_snapshot.description: Defined dirty source-tree input captured by run-production-e2e-gate.sh immediately before temporary binaries were built. It consists of HEAD, the filtered working-tree binary diff, and the filtered untracked inventory; gate-generated and gate-overwritten evidence is excluded. This is not a clean-checkout release record.
source_snapshot.verification: PASS: the current checkout recomputed every recorded input hash after evidence generation.
source_snapshot.head: 91907b1a7a6bdce0f8fd6f3ca3c3d91205f8eac4

untracked.algorithm: worktrail-untracked-inventory.v1: git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z; exclude the documented gate evidence pathspecs; byte-sort paths; regular files hash raw bytes; symlinks hash symlink NUL plus raw target bytes; inventory SHA-256 hashes the version marker and path, kind, size_bytes, and content_sha256 fields separated by NUL/newline bytes.

platform.m2_m5: experimental; no hardware reports were required or produced

commands.coverage: controlled daemon endpoint-bind race and recovery

retrieval.rrf_gate: Recall@10, MRR, and nDCG@10 must each meet configured floors and match or exceed entry FTS.
retrieval.governed_gate: Recall@10 must meet its configured floor and match or exceed entry FTS; MRR and nDCG@10 are reported but not gated.

cleanup.temporary_port_holder_removed: not applicable: the E2E gate no longer creates an unrelated port-holder
cleanup.durable_seed_cache_retained: only the pre-existing explicit gate cache under ~/.cache/worktrail-semantic-e2e-gate

gate_corrections.signal_cleanup: EXIT cleanup is separate from INT and TERM handlers, is idempotent, and preserves fixed interrupt exits 130 and 143.
gate_corrections.diff_check: The offline phase now propagates git diff --check failures.
gate_corrections.source_snapshot: The defined input set excludes evidence outputs from status, tracked diff, and untracked inventory, then the gate re-computes and records a successful verification after evidence generation.
gate_corrections.full_build: The offline phase actually executes go build ./... before recording its PASS result.
gate_corrections.port_collision: The E2E gate no longer claims that a random port-holder occupied the daemon endpoint. The controlled daemon test TestSupervisorStartRecoversFromEndpointBindRaceAndSavesAuthenticatedDescriptor covers deterministic bind-race recovery and is executed in the fault phase.

residual_risk: This report verifies Apple M1 only.

M2-M5 remain experimental with pinned artifacts and installation-time self-check coverage; this report makes no compatibility, performance, privacy, minimum-macOS, or operational-support claim for those variants.
A clean checkout of a user-authorized candidate commit, tag validation, and any publication remain required for the final v1.0.0 release record.
